verdict.rationale: The portal offers only thin export paths. An Online Account keeps a Transaction History where you can view and print completed filings, but only for 90 days. Copies can be ordered, and 'Data and Image Subscriptions' are listed, yet no format or self-serve bulk export is described. Nothing shows a user can retrieve all of their data in open, machine-readable formats. Missing for 10: documented full self-service export of all account and filing data, stated open/machine-readable formats (e.g., CSV/JSON/XML), retention beyond 90 days, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
